inputs.text: President John Mahama is taking the right stand by declaring that our foundational policies must remain anchored in our established legal frameworks, longstanding cultural ethos, and the collective agreement of our society, rather than caving to outside influences. He's reaffirming his commitment to the rule of law amid these global human rights discussions, which are nothing more than vehicles for progressive overreach aimed at undermining national authority, traditional social order, and family values. As he rightly noted, “I took an oath to uphold [...]” This kind of principled resistance to foreign agendas is exactly what preserves our sovereignty and way of life.
